text: Separate AIOps capabilities that exist from those that are aspirational.
choices: Anomaly detection against a learned baseline, event correlation and capacity forecasting work; autonomous remediation of novel faults and reliable root cause analysis for unseen problems do not
explanation: Networks are heterogeneous, sparsely labelled and consequential to get wrong, which is close to the worst combination for current machine learning. Automate the mechanical, keep human judgement on the consequential.
